title: project.create — Request
description: Create a project. Idempotent via operation_id. The server determines created_at; clients MUST NOT supply it.

operation_id.description: UUIDv7 (time-ordered). Same operation_id replays the cached response. Same operation_id with a different request body returns 409 Conflict.

slug.description: Stable, URL-safe identifier. Lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens; cannot start or end with hyphen. MUST be unique across all projects in the implementation.

repo_path.description: Canonical local path of the repo root. Optional.
